Today’s CME program was organized very well at the hotel. The ambience was professional, comfortable, and perfectly suitable for an academic discussion. The seating arrangement was properly managed, and the audio system was clear, which helped the presentation run smoothly.
The food quality was good, and the service staff was cooperative and attentive. Overall, the hospitality and management were satisfactory. The doctors actively participated, and the session was productive and interactive.
Overall, the venue selection was appropriate and can be recommended for future CME programs as well.( For Mr. Manish 10/10)
